target.normalLaunch: Steam / supported normal Cyberpunk 2077 launch after REDmod enable/deploy
target.launcherDisableExperience: REDlauncher Enable mods OFF yields Biology-inactive native Cyberpunk behavior without uninstall

releaseGate.reason: The integrated Biology package path is assembled and exact-compile-gated, and the player disable/uninstall contract is implemented in source; public release remains blocked on supported-install attended launcher ON/OFF and self-contained uninstall acceptance plus the existing native/overlap gates.

components.notes: Biology-owned REDmod identity/activation marker plus accepted project-original runtime. Tests, reports, staging, reference mods and source-only tooling stay out.

Directly required by accepted Biology-owned additive/wrapper runtime seams. It may still load while launcher mods are OFF, so it is never activation authority; player uninstall preserves the generic framework.
No Biology-owned native plugin. Retained only as transitive plumbing for ArchiveXL/Mod Settings; may remain loaded launcher-OFF and is preserved by player uninstall.
No direct Biology resource consumer. Retained only because the current Mod Settings adapter depends on it; preserve on player uninstall.

Current provider-neutral persistent adapter for Enable Biology and E3-inspired HUD + nameplates. Saved enabled=true cannot override launcher OFF. Replacement/removal remains the presentation/settings Lane C boundary; preserve on player uninstall.
No current Biology production source/data path requires TweakXL.
Merged Biology Ink/REDscript UI uses native APIs and has no Codeware dependency.
Current Biology runtime adds no custom input binding requiring Input Loader.
Historical research/provenance may remain in the repository, but executing Dark Future content is forbidden from Biology candidates.
Biology recreates accepted presentation with project-owned source plus native Cyberpunk UI. Project E3 runtime/assets remain forbidden.
No Cyberpunk executable, stock archive, final.redscripts, save or user settings may enter a Biology artifact.

artifactRequirements: Game-root-relative paths only for runtime payload.
The official first-party REDmod identity is mods/Biology and it owns an inert activation marker used to make launcher OFF fail closed.

The integrated artifact contains Biology project-original runtime plus pinned redscript and only the temporary RED4ext/ArchiveXL/Mod Settings chain still required by the unresolved settings-provider accessibility blocker.
Every installed file is represented by exact owner/component/route/uninstall-policy/SHA-256 metadata; shared framework roots are never recursively Biology-owned.
One hashed Uninstall Biology.exe is built into the same release artifact and consumes the matching schema-2 ownership receipt.
Player uninstall preserves generic/shared dependencies, saves and Biology preferences by default and refuses changed/ambiguous Biology-owned files.
INSTALL.txt documents the launcher ON/OFF contract, normal Steam launch target, and remaining attended gates.
Required licenses and third-party notices for every bundled generic dependency are included without development-only files.
Blocked or not-required components cause artifact construction to fail closed rather than silently expanding the dependency stack.
Public release remains gated until direct-game and attended acceptance is recorded; successful CI/exact compilation is not live acceptance.
